from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A party involved in the case with their legal role."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="Name or identifier of the party (e.g., 舟山海运公司)")
    role: str | None = Field(description="Role in the case (e.g., Appellant, Appellee)")

class Fee(BaseModel):
    """A court fee record including amount and who pays it."""
    amount: float | None = Field(description="Fee amount in CNY")
    level: str | None = Field(description="Instance level (e.g., First Instance, Second Instance)")
    bearer: str | None = Field(description="Party responsible for the fee")

class DocumentFacts(BaseModel):
    """Structured facts extracted from a single legal document for matching."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="Document identifier (e.g., 《判决文书1》")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="Case category (Civil, Administrative, Criminal)")
    outcome_type: str | None = Field(description="Ruling outcome (e.g., Maintain Original, Dismiss Retrial)")
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="Official case reference number")
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="List of parties with their roles")
    fees: list[Fee] = Field(description="List of court fee records")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentFacts]
